name: Law & Tender Desk
title: Law & Tender Desk: Hospitals Choose Their Own Suppliers

items.gist: Hospitals gain more freedom to choose chemical and equipment suppliers, so MMH sales should reach departments directly; the summary gives no start date, so check the official text first.
Resolution 48 of 2026 keeps premium support for ethnic minority patients steady, and an amended social insurance law takes effect March 1, 2027; finance should model hospital payment scenarios.
Decree 417 sets customs and tax rules for goods sold through e-commerce, which may limit cheap unclear imports of dental and eye supplies; MMH should watch online listing prices.
Resolution 402 sets the national master plan to 2030 with a vision to 2050, which may bring new regional hospitals and tenders; my guess is more equipment bids, so flag named regions early.
